Welcome to Dachshund Station! Your ultimate destination for dachshund care, mini dachshund tips, and dachshund puppy training guides. 

Join me (experienced doxie mom) and my two sweet long dogs, Eko and Gretta, for expert advice, health tips, and honest doxie gear reviews. Whether you're raising a brand-new puppy or an older sausage dog, we've got you covered.
